web.adminprivacymessage:
Select precinct, vote types and/or summary for each contest where there is concern for voter privacy. Votes for items marked will not be displayed on the public page. A new upload is required after selections are made and saved.

Refresh Data List
Prior to making selections, select the Refresh Data List button. This should be done if there were contests, precincts or vote types added or removed from the tabulation file uploaded to ENR to ensure the most current data is displayed. All prior selections will remain after refreshing.

Precinct Selection
Precinct information can be selected by precinct within a contest, for the entire contest or for all contests. Note: When the Show Areas Detail option in Election Details is not selected, then the precinct detail is already off and the precincts will not be selectable on the Voter Privacy filter.

Vote Type Selection
Vote type information can be selected to be hidden for all contests, each contest or each precinct. When only precinct(s) are selected, it will not hide on public page, only the detail.xls, detail.xml and detail.txt reports. Note: When the Vote Type toggle has been turned off in the public page then Voter Privacy for vote types will not be selectable.

Summary Selection
Summary information can be selected by contest or for all contests. When Summary is selected the Vote Type will automatically be selected.
